cohort: The participants were 4275 women and their newborns enrolled in the Pelotas 2015 Birth Cohort.
finding: Women who experienced obstetric violence during vaginal delivery had a higher probability of interrupting breastfeeding earlier than those who did not, and postpartum depression was not demonstrated as a mediator of this relationship.
mod_finding: Obstetric violence decreased the duration of breastfeeding only among women who had vaginal births, with no significant effect found for those who had c-section deliveries.
